section.title: org.osgi.service.transaction.control.jpa
section.para: Transaction Control JPA Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

listitem.para: JPAEntityManagerProvider - A specialized ResourceProvider suitable for obtaining JPA EntityManager instances.
JPAEntityManagerProviderFactory - A factory for creating JPAEntityManagerProvider instances

section.title: public interface JPAEntityManagerProvider extends ResourceProvider<EntityManager>
section.para: A specialized ResourceProvider suitable for obtaining JPA EntityManager instances.
Instances of this interface may be available in the Service Registry, or can be created using a JPAEntityManagerProviderFactory.

section.title: public interface JPAEntityManagerProviderFactory
section.para: A factory for creating JPAEntityManagerProvider instances
This factory can be used if the JPAEntityManagerProvider should not be a public service, for example to protect a username/password.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_LIFETIME = "osgi.connection.lifetime"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that connections in the pool should remain open

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_POOLING_ENABLED = "osgi.connection.pooling.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether connection pooling is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public static final String CONNECTION_TIMEOUT = "osgi.connection.timeout"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that the pool should wait for a connection

section.title: public static final String IDLE_TIMEOUT = "osgi.idle.timeout"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum amount of time that connections in the pool should remain idle before being closed

section.title: public static final String LOCAL_ENLISTMENT_ENABLED = "osgi.local.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether local enlistment is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public static final String MAX_CONNECTIONS = "osgi.connection.max"
section.para: The property used to set the maximum number of connections that should be held in the pool

section.title: public static final String MIN_CONNECTIONS = "osgi.connection.min"
section.para: The property used to set the minimum number of connections that should be held in the pool

section.title: public static final String OSGI_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER = "osgi.recovery.identifier"
section.para: The property used to set the recovery identifier that should be used by this resource

section.title: public static final String PRE_ENLISTED_DB_CONNECTION = "osgi.jdbc.enlisted"
section.para: The property used to indicate that database connections will be automatically enlisted in ongoing transactions without intervention from the JPA resource provider

section.title: public static final String TRANSACTIONAL_DB_CONNECTION = "osgi.jdbc.provider"
section.para: The property used to provide a JDBCConnectionProvider to the resource provider. This will be converted into a DataSource by the factory, and passed to the EntityManagerFactoryBuilder using the javax.persistence.jtaDataSource property

section.title: public static final String XA_ENLISTMENT_ENABLED = "osgi.xa.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether XA enlistment is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public static final String XA_RECOVERY_ENABLED = "osgi.recovery.enabled"
section.para: The property used to determine whether XA recovery is enabled for this resource provider

section.title: public JPAEntityManagerProvider getProviderFor(EntityManagerFactoryBuilder emfb, Map<String, Object> jpaProperties, Map<String, Object> resourceProviderProperties)

formalpara.title: jpaProperties
formalpara.para: The properties to pass to the EntityManagerFactoryBuilder in order to create the underlying EntityManagerFactory and EntityManager instances

formalpara.title: resourceProviderProperties
formalpara.para: Configuration properties to pass to the JPA Resource Provider runtime

section.para: Create a private JPAEntityManagerProvider using an EntityManagerFactoryBuilder. This call may fail with a TransactionException if the supplied configuration is invalid. Examples of invalid configuration include:

listitem.para: The properties request XA enlistment, but the provider implementation only supports local enlistment
The properties attempt to set a recovery alias, but the provider does not support recovery.

section.para: If XA transactions are used then this factory will provide configuration to ensure that the JPA Provider can participate correctly in ongoing transactions.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A JPAEntityManagerProvider that can be used in transactions

section.title: public JPAEntityManagerProvider getProviderFor(EntityManagerFactory emf, Map<String, Object> resourceProviderProperties)

formalpara.title: resourceProviderProperties
formalpara.para: Configuration properties to pass to the JDBC Resource Provider runtime

section.para: Create a private JPAEntityManagerProvider using an existing EntityManagerFactory. This call may fail with a TransactionException if the supplied configuration is invalid. Examples of invalid configuration include:

listitem.para: The properties request XA enlistment, but the provider implementation only supports local enlistment
The properties attempt to set a recovery alias, but the provider does not support recovery.

section.para: When using this method the client is responsible for all configuration of the EntityManagerFactory. This includes setting any relevant integration plugins for ensuring that the JPA provider can participate in the ongoing transaction context.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A JPAEntityManagerProvider that can be used in transactions

section.title: public void releaseProvider(JPAEntityManagerProvider provider)
section.para: Release a JPAEntityManagerProvider instance that has been created by this factory. Released instances are eligible to be shut down and have any remaining open connections closed.
Note that all JPAEntityManagerProvider instances created by this factory service are implicitly released when the factory service is released by this bundle.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the supplied resource was not created by this factory service instance.
